why: Task 608 recommended the predicate as an ASSERTION filed with the arm, and
task 609 measured why it cannot be the discriminator: at the failing
reading the collection was green / optimizer-ok / queue-0 and carried two
plain segments, and eight minutes later, at the passing reading, it was
green / optimizer-ok / queue-0 and carried the same two plain segments.
The predicate was false at both readings and the answers differed between
them. Refusing on it would refuse every pack that lands on a collection
carrying a routine plain segment; passing on it would have blessed the
transient. So it is evidence, filed with every verdict -- and a reading
that cannot be TAKEN at all is still an abort, because a check whose input
is unreadable must never read as clean.
